parsed.rationale: Both `LCDMinOffsetKey` and `LCDMaxOffsetKey` are type-alias-object declarations in the same file (`Shared/PlayerHeaderView/Sources/PlayerHeaderView/AccentColorEnvironment.swift`, lines 31 and 35) within the same package (`PlayerHeaderView`). Although the structural signal reports `shared_field_count: 1`, these two types encode semantically distinct concepts — a minimum offset key and a maximum offset key — whose structural similarity is coincidental. They are SwiftUI `EnvironmentKey`-style types that intentionally come in min/max pairs; collapsing them would destroy the semantic distinction the names carry. No restraint markers are present, but the domain concepts are intentionally separate.
